background: Sumitomo Mitsui Trust Group is Japan's largest trust bank, the holding company of Sumitomo Mitsui Trust Bank, whose business is asset management, custody, pensions and real-estate services alongside conventional lending and deposits.
synthesis: S&P rates the group A- and Moody's A2, both stable. Capital is on the weak side of Asian peers: CET1 of 11.1% is in the bottom quarter against a 15.7% median and leverage of 5.2% is below the 5.8% median, and both have fallen since 30 Jun 2025, CET1 by 1.0 points and leverage by 0.4 points. No liquidity ratios are held here. Nothing has been flagged in the last 90 days. The lowest CET1 of the Asian names held here, with a fee-driven trust business behind the ratings rather than ratio headroom.
